A Seeking Alpha opinion column noted the beat came alongside a GAAP net loss tied to acquisition costs, continued share buybacks, and dividend increases; none of the articles state a specific reason for the decline.
ABM_2024q4.explicit_reasons: The articles do not explicitly attribute the stock's move to any specific factor.
ABM_2024q4.implicit_reasons: Adjusted EPS of $0.90 beat the $0.86 consensus estimate by 4.65%, though down from $1.01 a year ago, and ABM posted a GAAP net loss due to acquisition costs per a Seeking Alpha opinion column. Revenue of $2.18 billion beat the consensus estimate by 4.30%, with a Seeking Alpha opinion column citing notable growth in the technical solutions and aviation divisions. The same column noted ABM continues robust share buybacks and dividend increases.

Revenue.text: Revenue of $2.18 billion for the quarter ended October 2024 beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate by 4.30%, up from $2.09 billion a year ago; a Seeking Alpha opinion column put fourth-quarter revenue growth at 4% year over year, beating consensus by $120 million, with notable growth in the technical solutions and aviation divisions.

Profits, costs and margin.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.90 beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $0.86 (a 4.65% surprise), though down from $1.01 a year ago; a Seeking Alpha opinion column noted ABM posted a GAAP net loss due to acquisition costs even as adjusted EPS surpassed expectations.

Debt, leverage and capital raise.text: A Seeking Alpha opinion column said ABM "continues robust share buybacks and dividend increases."
